source.source_name: Base Sirene des entreprises et de leurs établissements (SIREN, SIRET)
source.attribution: Source: INSEE, base Sirene, Licence Ouverte 2.0.

access.note: Bulk is no-auth. Daily deltas need a free API Sirene key (portail-api.insee.fr) — separate source api_sirene.

pagination.note: Monthly stock files (~960 MB units zip, ~2.83 GB establishments zip; Parquet variants). Dated URLs ROTATE monthly — resolve via the stable landing page / data.gouv.fr dataset API, do NOT hardcode.

snapshot.note: Prefer Parquet (typed, smaller). Persist raw; join StockEtablissement to StockUniteLegale on siren.

parsing.notes: siren/siret/codePostal stay strings. Resolve categorieJuridique / trancheEffectifs / NAF via INSEE label tables. Honor statutDiffusion=P (mask opted-out individuals).

fixture_requirements: unit with multiple establishments incl. siege

live_test_plan.smoke: Resolve current StockUniteLegale URL via data.gouv.fr dataset API; download a few MB; parse columns siren/denomination/etatAdministratif.
live_test_plan.full: Download both stocks (Parquet) behind an env gate; load to Postgres/DuckDB; join establishments to units; add daily deltas from api_sirene.

blockers: Dated stock URLs rotate monthly — must resolve dynamically.
